thread:
linh: quick check — i'm about to land a terraform change that replaces the per-model ConfigMap with an envFrom Secret + ConfigMap split. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123 

linh: goal is to move sensitive runtime knobs into a secret and keep non-sensitive flags in an envmap overlay so hops between environments are easier. wondering if this will cause noisy restarts or rollout pain for dedicated pools.

ravi: thanks for the heads-up. i skimmed the plan — TF will recreate the ConfigMap resource (rename + new secret resource). That will update the pod template hash and trigger a rolling restart for any deployment that uses `envFrom` on the old CM. expect restarts.

ash: heads-up — our kustomize overlays currently embed the configmap data in the overlay patch. if TF changes the name, the overlay patch will fail to apply until we update it. also checksum annotation pattern we use is `checksum/config-<name>` on deployments; make sure new secret is added to the checksum calculation.

linh: good call. i can update the overlay in the same PR, but don't want to force-replace everything in prod at once. can we do a canary/partial rollout?

sara: for model-specific knobs we already have a dynamic loader in the runtime that hot-reloads on CM changes for the inference pods. secrets do not hot-reload — they require a restart (or use projected volumes + CSI driver but we don't use that here). so expect restarts for the secret part only.

ravi: suggestion: split the rollout. first create the Secret resource and leave old CM in place. update runtime to prefer Secret if present (backwards-compatible), then do a controlled restart for a canary Deployment (10% traffic). once validated, switch other deployments and delete old CM.

jamie: +1. also add a migration job in the PR to copy existing values from the CM into the new Secret so there's no manual key-by-key work. e.g.:
```
kubectl get configmap models-runtime -n inference -o yaml | yq eval '.data' - > /tmp/models-data.yaml
# then create secret
kubectl create secret generic models-runtime-secret -n inference --from-file=/tmp/models-data.yaml
```
we can make that a one-shot k8s job in the infra repo.

linh: can you review the PR for that migration job, @jamie? i added a comment about annotation naming: `checksum/envmap-models` vs `checksum/secret-models` — should we keep both?

ash: keep both. deployment patch should include both annotations and compute with `sha256` of each resource's data. that way changes to either trigger the right rollouts.

deploy-bot: CI passed — infra/terraform-plan for PR #4123: no policy violations, plan shows 1 create, 1 replace, 2 update. (link: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/42) :white_check_mark:

linh: thanks — i'm going to add the migration job + overlay update in the same branch, then do the two-step rollout plan (create secret -> opt-in canary -> full switch -> delete cm).

ravi: ping me when the migration job is in so i can smoke test on staging. i can also do a one-off canary by patching the deployment selector to point to the small canary replicaset.

jamie: quick note on TF: avoid `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = false }` for this resource. we want `create_before_destroy = true` for zero-downtime creation when possible. if the provider can't do that, we should mark the resource to not destroy-critical on delete and handle deletion with kubectl after validation.

ash: also check the RBAC for pods that read secrets — the inference pod SA needs `get` for secrets if we switch to envFrom secret. i'm adding a terraform snippet to grant `read` on `secrets` to the inference SA in the PR.

linh: PR updated with migration job and RBAC tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123/files — canary plan in the PR description.

ravi: reviewing now. small nit: use `kubectl rollout status deployment/rd-models -n inference --watch=true` in the smoke script so it fails if the canary doesn't come up.

linh: will add. last Q — anything else i should add to the release notes for support?

sara: call out that per-model runtime flags moved: `configmap -> envmap (non-secret)` and sensitive knobs moved to `secret`. mention hot-reload semantics (cm: hot, secret: restart). also note the canary label to look for: `deployment.k8s.redwood/canary=true`.

jamie: once ravi gives a thumbs, i'll merge during the 0400-0600 UTC maintenance window. please avoid large config churn outside that window.

ravi: thumbs-up from me :thumbsup:

linh: great, thanks all. i'll post an ops checklist in the PR and tag this thread if anything odd pops up.

ash: fyi added logging in runtime to emit a metric when it falls back to CM vs secret so we can monitor adoption.

linh: awesome — closing this thread after the deploy. thanks!
